Qualitek mR Multi-Range Industrial Leak Tester
The standard for fast and dependable leak testing in light to medium-duty industrial applications.
Qualitek mR is the unparalleled standard for lightning-fast and dependable leak testing in light to medium-duty industrial applications. With a perfect fusion of cutting-edge multi-range (mR) leak and flow testing technology and the unmatched expertise of Uson, Qualitek mR sets the benchmark for excellence.
One of the standout features of Qualitek mR is its remarkable versatility, allowing you to utilize the same testing platform for a multitude of techniques. Whether it's pressure decay, differential pressure decay, vacuum decay, mass flow, forced decay, or sealed component testing, this exceptional device has got you covered. By consolidating various testing options into one product, Qualitek mR not only saves valuable time but also simplifies personnel training efforts.
As communication is key, Qualitek mR offers comprehensive communication options that seamlessly integrate with peripherals or automation equipment. With USB, Ethernet, RS 232, digital IO for PLC interface, Modbus, Profibus, DeviceNet, and email alerts, staying connected and in control has never been easier.

 Description 
For many years, Qualitek has been the proven standard for fast, reliable leak testing in industrial markets. This versatile and affordable product offers high-quality and accurate results for light- to medium-duty industrial leak testing applications.
Designed with an intuitive operating system, Qualitek mR ensures effortless learning and integration. Its computer-style mounting can be conveniently repositioned, providing optimal viewing angles from any direction.
Today’s mR line combines the best features of predecessors into one efficient and easy-to-use tester. Backed by Uson’s world-renowned reputation, Qualitek mR sets a new benchmark of accuracy and dependability in leak testing equipment for multi-range leak and flow testing equipment. Designed to be used on the benchtop or mounted into automated systems, the Qualitek mR is impressively simple to use. The convenient and easy-to-read display lends efficiency and helps prevent errors.
Qualitek mR is a highly configurable system that accepts a full range of tests and transducers. It contains the most current leak testing technology, including a powerful toolbox complete with a full menu of options including:
• Pressure profile 
 • Charting 
 • Data analysis 
 • Programs storage 
 • Scroll-and-click control wheel
Whether you're in the automotive, packaging, or industrial manufacturing industries, Qualitek mR is the ultimate choice for leak testing. From faucets, pumps, valves, shower heads, ink cartridges to castings, this versatile device caters to a wide range of applications, delivering unmatched precision and reliability.
